text: Bitcoin's modest 1.1% gain alongside a greed reading of 70 suggests cautious optimism, though Ethereum's lagging performance at +0.5% indicates uneven conviction across the majors. Bitcoin dominance holding steady at 59.2% with $62B in daily volume reflects a balanced market where large-cap momentum is not overwhelming smaller altcoins. The 7-day decline in the Fear & Greed index despite its elevated current level hints that recent gains may be meeting resistance rather than building sustainable momentum.
